title: Turkey’s monopolies watchdog takes on all comers
summary: From Meta, Adidas and Coca-Cola to poultry packers and hazelnut traders, the list of companies that have run up against Turkey’s Competition Authority (Rekabet Kurumu, or RK) continues to grow. Established in 1997, in the wake of Turkey’s customs union with the EU, the RK exists to benefit consumers by combatting cartels and monopolies, protecting the market mechanism and lowering barriers to market entry.
